Fares, minified

The harbor office publishes its fares twice a year, in spring and in autumn, on the notice board at the south landing.

The winter fares

Who pays

Every passenger over twelve pays the winter fare on every crossing made between the first of December and the last day of February, whatever landing the crossing starts from.

Who does not

Children under twelve cross free with an adult, and a season ticket bought before December keeps the summer fare printed on it until it ends.
